summary: Volleys (27 E6a): director.volleysOf groups a facility's merges within VOLLEY_WINDOW_MS = 20000 (x under D0, one local day, no day turn), checked by the B-15 guard on every non-member draft in range. Single-merge groups and overlapping groups are dropped. Direction.fuse joins each group's raw beats (schedule.fuseRanges in buildBeatSchedule). maneuvers.joinVolleys recasts the head as a carrier: cast = the members' union, agent = the lead (most merges, then the latest), the other members get the form 'joined'. Its echo holds the naming turns (volleyTurns/volleyPhases, VOLLEY_TURN_MS = 2540, at most 4 labels, everyone named once). Director step b and montage skip carriers; step d credits volley authors. Counts: Nova 2 volleys (4/10 merges), Quasar 6 (12/66), Pulsar 4 (8/30), Harbor 1 (2/7), Comet and Convoy 0. Built E6 savedMs: Nova 11760, Quasar 18700, Pulsar 7380, Harbor 5680, Comet/Convoy 0. E6+: Pulsar 2192, Quasar -1880. E1-E5 rows unchanged (they now run with volleys:false on both sides).

deviations: The new 05 rule is B-21, not B-20: B-20 already exists ('A region's own PRs').

03 (normative) changed: MomentForm 'joined', Volley, Direction.volleys/fuse, VolleyTurn, PlannedManeuver.volley, volleysOf, fuseRanges, volleyTurns/volleyPhases, the momentsOf/directorOf trailing params, PacingOptions.volleys. Call it out in the block note.
volleysOf takes a trailing VolleyOptions {windowMs?, guard?: false} object instead of a bare window number, so tests can turn the guard off.

The B-15 guard checks every non-member base draft in the range, not only the moments. This is stricter than the packet's wording, so Quasar gets 12 merges in volleys where the planner's sweep had 14-16.
pacing-built.ts has a new 'both' field so E5a-E5c run with volleys:false on both sides, which keeps their committed rows unchanged.
The E6 assumption text in pacing-candidates.json now starts with 'Built (E6): ...'.

limitations: Quasar E6+ costs 1.9 s: k is already at the 2x ceiling and volley climaxes play at 1x.
Volley carriers now win daily climaxes on Quasar and Pulsar (they have the most people), so the golden's climax picks moved.
Fixtures don't exercise step d's volley-author credit: every volley author also has a 'first' or non-progress merge.
The B-15 e2e check leaves out agent.light. Across fused beats, per-person order is guarded only through pieces. A close inside a fused range may become an arc of the carrier.
No same-run before/after perf e2e at the start commit (that needs a worktree). The perf figures are the in-process schedule probe plus the perf spec matching the earlier perf-before run.
